title: LLMs Hands-On: Transformers, Hugging Face, RAG, MCP & Context Engineering
blurb: The hands-on and internals companion to the AI Engineering track: build attention and BPE in numpy, drive the Hugging Face stack, ship RAG and LoRA fine-tunes, write MCP servers, and engineer context for long-running agents.
sources: Hugging Face LLM Course & Agents Course (huggingface.co/learn)
Hugging Face docs: Transformers v5, Tokenizers, Datasets, PEFT, TRL, Hub, TGI
Anthropic Engineering: Building effective agents; Effective context engineering for AI agents; Writing tools for agents
Vaswani et al. 2017; Su et al. 2021 (RoPE); Hu et al. 2021 (LoRA); Dettmers et al. 2023 (QLoRA); Rafailov et al. 2023 (DPO)

modules.title: Transformers from Scratch
modules.summary: Embeddings, attention, masking, normalisation, positional encodings (sinusoidal and RoPE), FFN/MoE and the architecture families, built up in numpy.

lessons.title: From embeddings to scaled dot-product attention
The transformer block: multi-head, norms, residuals, FFN and MoE
Positional encodings, RoPE, KV cache and architecture families

modules.title: Tokenization
modules.summary: BPE, WordPiece, Unigram/SentencePiece and byte-level tokenizers; special tokens and chat templates.

lessons.title: Subword tokenizers: BPE, WordPiece, Unigram, byte-level
Special tokens, chat templates and tokenizer pitfalls

modules.title: The Hugging Face Ecosystem, Hands-On
modules.summary: Hub, model cards, pipelines, Auto classes, generate() and decoding, datasets, Trainer, Accelerate, TGI/vLLM, Inference Providers and Spaces.

lessons.title: Hub, pipelines, Auto classes and generate()
Datasets, Trainer, Accelerate and serving (TGI, vLLM, Spaces)

modules.title: Embeddings & Vector Search
modules.summary: Sentence embeddings, similarity metrics, exact vs approximate search (HNSW, IVF, PQ) and the vector database landscape.

lessons.title: Embeddings and similarity: from sentence-transformers to Matryoshka
ANN indexes (HNSW, IVF, PQ) and vector databases

modules.title: Building RAG End-to-End
modules.summary: Ingestion, chunking, metadata, hybrid search with RRF, cross-encoder reranking, citations, RAG evaluation, GraphRAG and agentic RAG.

lessons.title: Ingestion, parsing and chunking strategies
Hybrid retrieval, fusion, reranking and grounded generation
Evaluating RAG; GraphRAG and agentic RAG

modules.title: Finetuning Hands-On
modules.summary: LoRA and QLoRA maths and code with peft, SFT with TRL, preference tuning with DPO, data formatting and evaluation.

lessons.title: PEFT: LoRA, QLoRA and friends
SFT and DPO with TRL: data, training loop, evaluation

modules.title: Agents & Tool Use
modules.summary: Function calling with JSON Schema, the agent loop, ReAct, Anthropic's workflow patterns, multi-agent systems and frameworks such as smolagents.

lessons.title: Function calling: schemas, the tool loop and parsing
Workflows vs agents: the five patterns
ReAct, planning, multi-agent systems and frameworks

modules.title: Model Context Protocol
modules.summary: Why MCP exists, hosts/clients/servers, JSON-RPC messages, legacy handshake vs the 2026 stateless protocol, transports, primitives, building servers and securing them.

lessons.title: Why MCP: architecture and primitives
The wire protocol: JSON-RPC, lifecycle, transports
Building, connecting and securing MCP servers

modules.title: Context Engineering
modules.summary: Attention budgets and context rot, system prompt altitude, just-in-time retrieval, compaction, memory, sub-agents, tool design and prompt caching.

lessons.title: The context window as a budget: rot, altitude and retrieval
Long-horizon agents: compaction, notes, memory and sub-agents
Designing tools for agents and prompt caching

modules.title: LLM Application Engineering
modules.summary: Structured outputs, streaming, guardrails and prompt-injection defence, observability and tracing, evals in CI, and cost/latency engineering.

lessons.title: Structured outputs and streaming
Guardrails and prompt-injection defence
Observability, evals in CI, cost and latency
